reviewer: authoring agent; agent inspection only, no human approval inferred
findings: Long low nose, swept cabin, raised rear haunches, curved openings, dark side intakes, mirrors and front/rear lamp distinctions read coherently across all eight raw views.

Near wheels are visible in obliques; far wheels occlude behind the body in side views and both tracks show in front/rear views. No obvious floating wheel, body intrusion, clipping or glass spill was seen.
Broad face-painted highlights remain stable and glass has continuous geometric dark borders; native finishing adds one inward silhouette pixel without changing the anchor or fitting each view.
First pass had broken subpixel seams; shell-following strips and wider hood lines improved them before this final output. No per-view pixel redrawing was used.

All eight final sprites were inspected together at native scale in sheet.png and enlarged nearest in comparison.png. Hood seams retain some stair steps; small handles, vents and rim spokes simplify with point sampling.

All eight decoded GIF frames were inspected in a contact sheet. Eight unique frames and 250 ms durations were checked programmatically. Continuous animated playback was not inspected. The GIF includes a fixed ground-origin crosshair guide over the sprite; final PNGs contain no guide.
The compact-4 source red roles are pink-magenta, and flat highlight bands look graphic rather than glossy. This is the intended inexpensive unlit baseline, not a detailed shaded result.
remainingLimitations: No human art approval, runtime performance evidence or integration qualification.
No steering or suspension qualification; neutral rolling cylinder clearance and independent wheel transforms were checked.
GLB has geometric internal trim but the sprite finishing silhouette ink is external to its mesh.
